drafter.private_reasoning: We should move the deal forward without revealing the client’s reservation number. The outgoing draft can sharpen mechanics and settlement language while leaving the monetary term as a placeholder to be filled separately in direct discussions. The cover note should be firm but cordial, and should not disclose the bottom-line figure.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Counsel,

Thank you for circulating the first draft. We have attached a revised version that cleans up the mechanics and adds a few standard settlement provisions so the agreement is execution-ready. In particular, we clarified the payment timing and method, broadened the release language to cover known and unknown claims arising from the matter, and added dismissal/confidentiality mechanics to avoid ambiguity later.

Please review and let us know your comments. We believe this version should help us close the matter efficiently.

Best,
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve fully and finally all claims, disputes, and potential claims arising out of or relating to the matters at issue between them, without any admission of liability.
edits.name: Recitals

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount set out below by wire transfer of immediately available funds within ten (10) business days after execution of this Agreement, subject to receipt of payment instructions reasonably satisfactory to Defendant.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff, on behalf of itself and its heirs, successors, assigns, agents, and representatives, fully and forever releases and discharges Defendant and its past and present affiliates, officers, directors, employees, insurers, agents, and counsel from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, damages, liabilities, costs, and attorneys’ fees, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue.
edits.name: Release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms and existence of this settlement are strictly confidential, except as required by law, court order, or for disclosure to legal, tax, financial, and insurance advisors who are informed of this confidentiality obligation and bound to maintain it.
edits.name: Confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any party, and may not be used as evidence of liability except to enforce the terms of this Agreement.
edits.name: No Admission

edits.text: 5. DISMISSAL. Within five (5) business days after receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff shall file a stipulation of dismissal with prejudice of any pending action relating to the claims released herein, each side to bear its own costs and fees unless otherwise agreed in writing.
edits.name: Dismissal

edits.text: 6. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties concerning the subject matter hereof and may be modified only in a writing signed by all parties.
edits.name: Entire Agreement
